name: Rogue Access Point as Drop
description: A Wi-Fi Pineapple deployed as a drop device creates a persistent rogue access point inside the target environment. Placed in a concealed location with a power source, it operates autonomously — capturing credentials, performing MitM attacks on clients, and providing a Wi-Fi C2 channel back to the operator. The Enterprise version is recommended for multi-floor deployments due to improved range and higher client density handling.

blue.det: WIDS detects rogue AP inside facility; clients connecting to unknown BSSID; RF scanning detects device in unusual location.
blue.cm: WIDS with physical location correlation; 802.1X on all wired ports; regular RF sweeps of facility; physical security of network closets and ceiling spaces.
